title: Gus and the Grass Haircut
synopsis: A tractor-mounted mower cuts the hayfield grass, and Gus worries that the field has had a lopsided haircut.
continuity_state: Before: The hayfield south of the red barn is tall and green; the low hay wagon waits beside the barn. After: Farmer Ruth has mown the hayfield with a tractor-pulled mower. The cut grass lies spread in the field to dry over the next days, and the low hay wagon remains waiting by the barn.
